entries.label: FAQ forum
entries.message: Browse the FAQ forum — check the existing posts first, then open a new one if yours isn't there.

entries.label: Archdemon Crown crafting
entries.message: There's already a troubleshooting post for the Archdemon Crown — add your question there.

entries.label: Path of Building (PoB)
entries.message: Path of Building is the community build planner. Paste your share code with `/pob <code>` and the bot will decode it. More info is in the FAQ forum.

entries.label: PoE third-party tools
entries.message: Common PoE tools: Path of Building, poe.ninja, the official trade site, craftofexile.com. Check the FAQ forum for setup guides.
